context.description: The task-ui classifies every unit only from the status tags
context.gherkin:
Scenario: UI1 The task-ui classifies every unit only from the status tags
    Given a status with waiting, active, trusted, dead, blocked and cancelled tasks
    When the Board and the counts read it
    Then waiting tasks are in WAITING, active tasks in the column of their phase, stopped tasks in STOPPED and the other ended tasks in TRUSTED
    And STOPPED groups dead tasks, then blocked tasks, then the rest
    And the counts, the focus and the next running task come from the tags
    And the task-ui keeps no list of active or ended state names

  @phase4 @core
